theorem YulangClosure.Control.call_request_unwind_exists : ∀ {W : Type} (md : YulangClosure.Control.Metadata W)
  (world : W) (op : YulangClosure.TypedCall.OperationInstance) (payload : YulangClosure.TypedCall.Value)
  (continuation : YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp) (observed : List YulangClosure.TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
  (frames : List YulangClosure.TypedCall.ContextFrame) (view : YulangClosure.TypedCall.CallView)
  (result : YulangClosure.Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat) (views : List YulangClosure.TypedCall.ViewOccurrence)
  (receipts : List YulangClosure.TypedCall.ReceiptSlot) (suffix : List YulangClosure.Control.Frame),
  ∃ world' scopes',
    YulangClosure.Prefix (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep md) (frames.length + 1)
      { world := world, head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.requesting op payload continuation observed,
        frames := frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes, viewContext := views,
        receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix }
      { world := world',
        head :=
          YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.requested op payload
            (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.captureFrames frames continuation),
        frames := [], callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes', viewContext := observed,
        receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix } :=
fun {W} md world op payload continuation observed frames view result scopes views receipts suffix =>
  List.rec (motive := fun frames =>
    ∀ (world : W) (continuation : YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp) (scopes : List Nat),
      ∃ world' scopes',
        YulangClosure.Prefix (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep md) (frames.length + 1)
          { world := world, head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.requesting op payload continuation observed,
            frames := frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes, viewContext := views,
            receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix }
          { world := world',
            head :=
              YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.requested op payload
                (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.captureFrames frames continuation),
            frames := [], callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes', viewContext := observed,
            receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix })
    (fun world continuation scopes =>
      Exists.intro world
        (Exists.intro scopes
          (YulangClosure.Prefix.snoc
            (YulangClosure.Prefix.refl
              { world := world, head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.requesting op payload continuation observed,
                frames := [], callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes, viewContext := views,
                receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix })
            (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep.finishRequest world op payload continuation observed view result
              scopes views receipts suffix))))
    (fun frame frames ih world continuation scopes =>
      YulangClosure.TypedCall.ContextFrame.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
        frame = t →
          ∃ world' scopes',
            YulangClosure.Prefix (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep md) ((frame :: frames).length + 1)
              { world := world, head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.requesting op payload continuation observed,
                frames := frame :: frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes,
                viewContext := views, receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix }
              { world := world',
                head :=
                  YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.requested op payload
                    (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.captureFrames (frame :: frames) continuation),
                frames := [], callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes', viewContext := observed,
                receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix })
        frame
        (fun body h =>
          Eq.symm h ▸
            Exists.casesOn (ih world (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.captureBind continuation body) scopes)
              fun world' h =>
              Exists.casesOn h fun scopes' htail =>
                Exists.intro world'
                  (Exists.intro scopes'
                    (id
                      (YulangClosure.Control.prefix_prepend✝ htail
                        (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep.requestBind world op payload continuation body observed
                          frames view result scopes views receipts suffix)))))
        (fun owner h =>
          Eq.symm h ▸
            Exists.casesOn
              (ih (md.suspendScope world owner) (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.scope owner continuation)
                (owner :: scopes))
              fun world' h =>
              Exists.casesOn h fun scopes' htail =>
                Exists.intro world'
                  (Exists.intro scopes'
                    (id
                      (YulangClosure.Control.prefix_prepend✝ htail
                        (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep.requestScope world owner op payload continuation observed
                          frames view result scopes views receipts suffix)))))
        (fun effectView resultView h =>
          Eq.symm h ▸
            Exists.casesOn
              (ih (md.suspendView world effectView.identity)
                (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.expose effectView resultView continuation) scopes)
              fun world' h =>
              Exists.casesOn h fun scopes' htail =>
                Exists.intro world'
                  (Exists.intro scopes'
                    (id
                      (YulangClosure.Control.prefix_prepend✝ htail
                        (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep.requestExpose world effectView resultView op payload
                          continuation observed frames view result scopes views receipts suffix)))))
        (fun input output body h =>
          Eq.symm h ▸
            Exists.casesOn (ih world (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.captureBind continuation body) scopes)
              fun world' h =>
              Exists.casesOn h fun scopes' htail =>
                Exists.intro world'
                  (Exists.intro scopes'
                    (id
                      (YulangClosure.Control.prefix_prepend✝ htail
                        (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep.requestAdapter world op payload continuation observed
                          input output body frames view result scopes views receipts suffix)))))
        (Eq.refl frame))
    frames world continuation scopes

theorem YulangClosure.Control.call_failure_unwind_exists : ∀ {World : Type} (md : YulangClosure.Control.Metadata World)
  (world : World) (reason : YulangClosure.Original.Failure) (frames : List YulangClosure.TypedCall.ContextFrame)
  (view : YulangClosure.TypedCall.CallView) (result : YulangClosure.Original.Ty) (scopes : List Nat)
  (views : List YulangClosure.TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) (receipts : List YulangClosure.TypedCall.ReceiptSlot)
  (suffix : List YulangClosure.Control.Frame),
  ∃ nextWorld,
    YulangClosure.Prefix (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep md) (frames.length + 1)
      { world := world, head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.active (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.fail reason),
        frames := frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes, viewContext := views,
        receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix }
      { world := nextWorld, head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.failed reason, frames := [], callView := view,
        resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes, viewContext := views, receiptSlots := receipts,
        literalSuffix := suffix } :=
fun {World} md world reason frames view result scopes views receipts suffix =>
  List.rec (motive := fun frames =>
    ∀ (world : World),
      ∃ nextWorld,
        YulangClosure.Prefix (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep md) (frames.length + 1)
          { world := world, head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.active (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.fail reason),
            frames := frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes, viewContext := views,
            receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix }
          { world := nextWorld, head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.failed reason, frames := [], callView := view,
            resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes, viewContext := views, receiptSlots := receipts,
            literalSuffix := suffix })
    (fun world =>
      Exists.intro world
        (YulangClosure.Prefix.snoc
          (YulangClosure.Prefix.refl
            { world := world, head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.active (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.fail reason),
              frames := [], callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes, viewContext := views,
              receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix })
          (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep.finishFailure world reason view result scopes views receipts suffix)))
    (fun frame frames ih world =>
      Exists.casesOn (md.failWorld_total world (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.contextControlFrame frame))
        fun middleWorld hcleanup =>
        have hstep :=
          YulangClosure.TypedCall.ContextFrame.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
            frame = t →
              YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep md
                { world := world,
                  head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.active (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.fail reason),
                  frames := frame :: frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes,
                  viewContext := views, receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix }
                { world := middleWorld,
                  head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.active (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.fail reason),
                  frames := frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes,
                  viewContext := views, receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix })
            frame
            (fun body h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun frame =>
                md.failWorld world (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.contextControlFrame frame) middleWorld →
                  YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep md
                    { world := world,
                      head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.active (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.fail reason),
                      frames := frame :: frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes,
                      viewContext := views, receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix }
                    { world := middleWorld,
                      head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.active (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.fail reason),
                      frames := frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes,
                      viewContext := views, receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix })
                (fun hcleanup =>
                  YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep.failBind world reason body middleWorld hcleanup frames view
                    result scopes views receipts suffix)
                (Eq.symm h) hcleanup)
            (fun owner h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun frame =>
                md.failWorld world (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.contextControlFrame frame) middleWorld →
                  YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep md
                    { world := world,
                      head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.active (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.fail reason),
                      frames := frame :: frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes,
                      viewContext := views, receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix }
                    { world := middleWorld,
                      head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.active (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.fail reason),
                      frames := frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes,
                      viewContext := views, receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix })
                (fun hcleanup =>
                  YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep.failScope world reason owner middleWorld hcleanup frames view
                    result scopes views receipts suffix)
                (Eq.symm h) hcleanup)
            (fun effectView resultView h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun frame =>
                md.failWorld world (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.contextControlFrame frame) middleWorld →
                  YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep md
                    { world := world,
                      head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.active (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.fail reason),
                      frames := frame :: frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes,
                      viewContext := views, receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix }
                    { world := middleWorld,
                      head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.active (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.fail reason),
                      frames := frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes,
                      viewContext := views, receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix })
                (fun hcleanup =>
                  YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep.failExpose world reason effectView resultView middleWorld
                    hcleanup frames view result scopes views receipts suffix)
                (Eq.symm h) hcleanup)
            (fun input output body h =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun frame =>
                md.failWorld world (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.contextControlFrame frame) middleWorld →
                  YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep md
                    { world := world,
                      head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.active (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.fail reason),
                      frames := frame :: frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes,
                      viewContext := views, receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix }
                    { world := middleWorld,
                      head := YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.active (YulangClosure.TypedCall.Comp.fail reason),
                      frames := frames, callView := view, resultType := result, scopeContext := scopes,
                      viewContext := views, receiptSlots := receipts, literalSuffix := suffix })
                (fun hcleanup =>
                  YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep.failAdapter world reason input output body middleWorld hcleanup
                    frames view result scopes views receipts suffix)
                (Eq.symm h) hcleanup)
            (Eq.refl frame);
        Exists.casesOn (ih middleWorld) fun nextWorld hrest =>
          Exists.intro nextWorld (id (YulangClosure.Control.prependFailureUnwindStep✝ hstep hrest)))
    frames world

theorem YulangClosure.Control.call_prefix_append : ∀ {C : Type} {step : C → C → Prop} {n m : Nat} {a b c : C},
  YulangClosure.Prefix step n a b → YulangClosure.Prefix step m b c → YulangClosure.Prefix step (n + m) a c :=
fun {C} {step} {n m} {a b c} hfirst hsecond =>
  YulangClosure.Prefix.rec (motive := fun {m} {b c} hsecond =>
    YulangClosure.Prefix step n a b → YulangClosure.Prefix step (n + m) a c) (fun c hfirst => id hfirst)
    (fun {m} {b middle c} hprefix hstep ih hfirst => YulangClosure.Prefix.snoc (ih hfirst) hstep) hsecond hfirst

  YulangClosure.Control.FramesTyped sig suffix (YulangClosure.Control.Ty.original term.resultType) result →
    YulangClosure.Prefix (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep md) n
        (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.initial term world suffix) s →
      s.head = YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.requesting op payload continuation observed →
        ∃ t,
          YulangClosure.Prefix (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep md) (n + (s.frames.length + 1))
              (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.initial term world suffix) t ∧
            t.head =
                YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.requested op payload
                  (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.captureFrames s.frames continuation) ∧
              t.frames = [] ∧
                YulangClosure.Control.CallStateTyped sig t result ∧
                  t.resultType = term.resultType ∧
                    t.literalSuffix = suffix ∧

                        t.receiptSlots = s.receiptSlots ∧

                                (YulangClosure.Original.extend YulangClosure.Original.emptyContext op.responseType)
                                (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.captureFrames s.frames continuation) t.resultType :=
fun {W} {sig} {md} {term} {world} {suffix} {result} {n} {s} {op} {payload} {continuation} {observed} hsuffix hp hhead =>

      have hresult0 :=

        Eq.trans hliteral (Eq.refl (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.initial term world suffix).literalSuffix);
      YulangClosure.Control.CallState.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
        YulangClosure.Prefix (YulangClosure.Control.CallControlStep md) n
            (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.initial term world suffix) x →
          x.head = YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.requesting op payload continuation observed →
            YulangClosure.Control.CallStateTyped sig x result →
              x.resultType = (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.initial term world suffix).resultType →

                              YulangClosure.Control.CallHead.requested op payload
                                (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.captureFrames x.frames continuation) ∧
                            t.frames = [] ∧
                              YulangClosure.Control.CallStateTyped sig t result ∧
                                t.resultType = term.resultType ∧

                                            YulangClosure.TypedCall.CompTyped
                                              (YulangClosure.Original.extend YulangClosure.Original.emptyContext
                                                op.responseType)

                                receiptSlots := receiptSlotsS, literalSuffix := literalSuffixS }.frames
                            continuation) ∧
                      t.frames = [] ∧
                        YulangClosure.Control.CallStateTyped sig t result ∧
                          t.resultType = term.resultType ∧
                            t.literalSuffix = suffix ∧
                              t.callView =
                                  { world := worldS, head := headS, frames := framesS, callView := callViewS,
                                      resultType := resultTypeS, scopeContext := scopeContextS,
                                      viewContext := viewContextS, receiptSlots := receiptSlotsS,
                                      literalSuffix := literalSuffixS }.callView ∧
                                t.receiptSlots =

                                        resultType := resultTypeS, scopeContext := scopeContextS,
                                        viewContext := viewContextS, receiptSlots := receiptSlotsS,
                                        literalSuffix := literalSuffixS }.receiptSlots ∧

                                        (YulangClosure.Original.extend YulangClosure.Original.emptyContext
                                          op.responseType)
                                        (YulangClosure.Control.CallState.captureFrames
                                          { world := worldS, head := headS, frames := framesS, callView := callViewS,
                                              resultType := resultTypeS, scopeContext := scopeContextS,
                                              viewContext := viewContextS, receiptSlots := receiptSlotsS,
